title.narrative: Pre-emptive early cash for enhancement of food security outcomes for drought-threatened households in Marsabit County

description.narrative: A report of Marsabit county current drought situation and ongoing interventions that was published in June 2022 highlights the current situation and all the interventions being carried out by various actors. According to that report, out of a total of 7,667 households in the target region( 4,477 in Maikona and 3,190 in Kargi), a total of 5,119 households( 2,688 in Maikona and 2,431 in Kargi are vulnerable and in need of assistance. Of these, A total of 3,243 households(2,127 in Maikona and 1,116 in Kargi) are being supported by other cash programs, leaving a gap of 1,876 households of which 1,060 are being targeted by this proposed action. The report also ranks the two wards among the highest in need of assistance within the county. The proposed action will go a long way in narrowing the gap in coverage within the target regions and greatly help in preventing the targeted households from dropping further into severer food security conditions. Of the total beneficiaries, 551 are women and 509 are men. Thirteen and twelve women and men with disabilities respectively are also included in the target number.

The project aims at enhancing the food security of 1,060 drought -threatened households in Maikona and Kargi wards of Marsabit County through the distribution of early cash and dissemination of suitable related messages. Guided by assessments conducted by the cash working group and pegged on the minimum food expenditure basket(MFEB), provisions will cover 75% of the MFEB based on the IPC classification of IPC 4 in the county. Disbursements will be done in two cycles of equal amounts using Safaricom's M-Pesa mobile money transfer between July and September 2022.

The project's expected impact is the enhancement of the food security of some 1,060 drought threatened households in Maikona and Kargi wards of Marsabit county. This is to be realised through the attainment of two outcomes: (1) Target vulnerable households have been supported with early cash, and (2) Target households have been reached with suitable related messages on the utilization of the distributed cash for realisation of their food needs.
